# Osama Malik (Usama Malik), AI Agent Engineer

> Osama Malik (also written Usama Malik) is an AI agent engineer at Onlinx Solutions in Islamabad, Pakistan, and a freelance AI agent developer. He builds voice agents, RAG systems, tool calling agents, and LLM cost and security guards, and works remotely with teams in the US, UK, Europe, Australia and the Gulf. Contact: usmamalik346@gmail.com

## Projects and case studies
- [BleedStop, LLM cost guard](https://osamamalik.me/bleedstop.html): cost abuse control for LLM, SMS and payment APIs with Redis budgets and measured results
- [Agent Receptionist case study](https://osamamalik.me/portfolio-agent/case-study.html): tool calling AI agent for appointment businesses, with cited RAG, policy routing and evals
- [Genkit #6346 write-up](https://osamamalik.me/projects/genkit-openai-base64-embeddings/): merged fix so the Genkit Python OpenAI embedder no longer fails validation when encodingFormat is base64
- [Strands Agents #4313 write-up](https://osamamalik.me/projects/strands-agentresult-json-bytes/): merged fix so AgentResult.to_dict serializes to JSON when a Bedrock message contains raw bytes
- [Pipecat #5760 write-up](https://osamamalik.me/projects/pipecat-5760-function-call-timeout/): merged fix so function call timeouts stay armed across intermediate results
- [POS and inventory platform](https://osamamalik.me/projects/pos-inventory-platform/): production point of sale work at Onlinx Solutions, ASP.NET Core and Angular 19
- [Doctor booking platform](https://osamamalik.me/projects/doctor-booking-platform/): booking flows built at IT Pixelz for about 50 doctors across 20 clinics
